subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution through a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface, and should that be a dedicated `/admin/update` endpoint or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC method around `update.run`?
rationale: Current code treats `update.run` as an admin-scoped control-plane write and current Admin HTTP RPC exposes only `update.status`, so a network-triggered update endpoint changes the security boundary and API shape.

options.title: Split version from update authority
options.body: Track health/version metadata in the narrower issue and require a separate maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Allow or wrap `update.run` only with explicit private-ingress, auth-scope, audit, rate-limit, target-version, and handoff-failure requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution on existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split version from update authority
recommendation.body: Track health/version metadata in the narrower issue and require a separate maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across Admin HTTP RPC, gateway update flow, and adjacent version resolver work.
